architecture: WebXR live mapping + automatic high-quality Depth Anything RGB-D frame collection and metric alignment to WebXR + explicit user frame review + optional MobileSAM ROI/object creation + independent optional audio + dedicated Stage-5 renderer
patch: H5W15: Depth Anything captures more frequent, quality-gated and pose-diverse frames automatically, exposes their fusion/rejection result in a review gallery, and accepts user-saved photos during mapping. MobileSAM no longer runs after an ROI gesture: it is loaded and invoked only when the user explicitly selects a reviewed frame, draws an ROI and presses Applica SAM.
